title: Sum any numeric type
prompt: Implement `static T Sum<T>(T[] values) where T : INumber<T>` summing all elements starting from T.Zero, and `static T Average<T>(T[] values) where T : INumber<T>` returning Sum / count (use T.CreateTruncating for the count). Works for int, double, decimal — one implementation.

tests.name: int
tests.hint: T.Zero starts the fold; use += via operators on INumber<T>.

tests.name: double
tests.hint: Same generic code; the type argument brings its own arithmetic.
